reviews.title: They lie
reviews.body: What this product claims "for dog with strong teeth" is patently unfalsifiable. So if it destroyes your dogs molars, it is your fault for not knowing whether it's teeth is strong enough. That is just component bs. It progressively destroyed my dogs molars over a year and half. We didn't know. Dogs molars are not designed to chew through nylon. Stronger dogs are at more risk than smaller dogs. It will slowly destroy your dogs teeth. It is just a matter of time. Very unethical company.

reviews.title: Not worth it for hard chewers
reviews.body: I honestly wouldn’t recommend this for hard-chewing puppies. My puppy is only 6 months old and chewed through it pretty quickly. I expected it to last much longer, especially since it’s advertised for aggressive chewers. It may be fine for dogs who aren’t heavy chewers, but for a puppy who really likes to chew, I don’t think it’s worth the price. I would definitely do your research before buying this, especially if you have a puppy who chews hard. There are better options out there that are more durable and safer for their teeth.

reviews.title: 10/10 would gnaw again
reviews.body: Monty consider myself a bit of a connoisseur when it comes to long-lasting chewies. I’ve tried shoes, table legs, and cardboard boxes, but this Benebone wishbone is the real deal. Here’s why it gets 5 paws: * Ergonomics: The curved wishbone design means I can lock it down effortlessly between my front paws. No weird mouth acrobatics needed—just pure, comfortable leverage. * Texture & Crunch: The ends get all nicely textured and frayed as you work on them, giving it that perfect, satisfying bite-feel that keeps a hardworking pup in the zone for hours. * Built to Last: Durable enough for aggressive gnawing, so I don't wear it down in five minutes flat. My humans thought they were just buying me a toy, but they actually bought themselves pure peace and quiet while I’m hard at work. Verdict: Highly recommend for all professional chewers. Please buy ten more!
